keySentence: She was hurt but tried to stay glad.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna was in bed. She could not walk. But she tried to be happy. She was hurt but tried to stay glad.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna lay in bed feeling sad for the very first time. She could not walk or run or play outside anymore. For a moment, she thought the glad game was impossible. She was hurt but tried to stay glad by counting her blessings. She could still see, hear, and hold her friends' hands. Even in pain, she looked for something to be thankful for.
